_about: What guests say, per cruise, summarised from the latest ~60-70 guest reviews of each listing (read 17 Nov 2026), plus the questions travellers keep asking in Budapest Facebook groups. Counts are 'X of Y recent reviews'. Keyed by the card's review anchor. Never quote or name the review site in answers.

general.a: At night the Parliament, Castle and bridges are floodlit, which is what most guests remember. Book a sailing that starts after full dark, or one that starts around sunset to see the lights come on. The Parliament's lights go off at 22:00.

general.q: Is it cold on the river in winter?
general.a: Yes, open decks are cold from November to February. Every boat on this page has a heated indoor area; bring a warm layer if you want to stand outside for photos.

general.q: Do I need to book ahead?
general.a: No, you can book on the same day too. Evening sailings in December and on weekends can sell out, though, Cruises booked through GetYourGuide have free cancellation up to 24 hours before and you pay nothing today; Legenda also has free cancellation up to 24 hours before and can move tickets to another day at its pier; Silverline refunds cancellations made over 24 hours ahead minus a 10% fee.
15 to 20 minutes before departure. On boats without assigned seats, arriving 30 minutes early gets the best spots.

general.q: Which cruises have a live guide?
general.a: Most use an audio guide (headsets or your own phone with a QR code). Bring headphones for phone-based guides.

general.q: Can I bring my own drinks?
general.a: Only on La Perla (bring your own drinks, no bar). Every other boat here sells drinks on board and does not allow your own food or drinks.

River Diva is the one boat on this page confirmed as wheelchair accessible. Some Legenda boats are accessible but not all, so ask Legenda which boat runs your sailing; on the Duna-Weser unlimited drinks cruise it varies by boat and dock. The others are not suitable for wheelchair users.

general.q: Can I bring a stroller or a dog?
general.a: Strollers: not allowed on the Kisfaludy paddle steamer or the 360° Panoramic Cruise; only folding strollers on the Duna-Weser cruise. Dogs: small dogs on a lead with a muzzle on Duna-Weser, pets allowed on La Perla; Silverline boats take service dogs only.
